prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 359e36cae0d1eea9
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback RX returned 0xe0 instead of expected 0xa5 at divider 64. Start-bit centering in state 1 correctly uses half-bit `2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider`, but data/stop sampling in state 10 and default uses `recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)` which is 16x too fast. This early sampling misaligns bit capture and produces the mismatch.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 359e36cae0d1eea9 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
